mapper.insert: insert into ingestion_item_execution ( item_id, execution_epoch, execution_kind, execution_status, phase, parse_attempt_id, claim_version, phase_retry_count, phase_started_at, next_action_at, lease_token, lease_until, error_code, error_message, created_at, updated_at, finished_at ) values ( #{itemId}, #{executionEpoch}, #{executionKind}, #{executionStatus}, #{phase}, #{parseAttemptId}, #{claimVersion}, #{phaseRetryCount}, #{phaseStartedAt}, #{nextActionAt}, #{leaseToken}, #{leaseUntil}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{finishedAt} )
mapper.select: select from ingestion_task order by created_at desc, id desc limit #{limit}
select from ingestion_task_item iti inner join ingestion_task it on it.id = iti.task_id where iti.task_id = #{taskId} order by iti.created_at asc, iti.id asc

select iti.id as item_id, iti.task_id, it.kb_id, iti.status as item_status, iti.updated_at as item_updated_at, iti.current_execution_id, coalesce(ie.execution_epoch, iti.execution_epoch, 1) as execution_epoch, ie.execution_status, coalesce(ipa.attempt_no, iti.parse_attempt, 1) as parse_attempt_no, coalesce(ipa.source_revision, iti.source_revision) as source_revision from ingestion_task_item iti inner join ingestion_task it on it.id = iti.task_id left join ingestion_item_execution ie on ie.id = iti.current_execution_id and ie.item_id = iti.id left join ingestion_item_parse_attempt ipa on ipa.id = ie.parse_attempt_id and ipa.item_id = iti.id where it.kb_id = #{kbId} and it.id = #{taskId} and iti.id = #{itemId}

select iti.id as item_id, iti.task_id, it.kb_id, iti.status as item_status, iti.updated_at as item_updated_at, iti.current_execution_id, coalesce(ie.execution_epoch, iti.execution_epoch, 1) as execution_epoch, ie.execution_status, coalesce(ipa.attempt_no, iti.parse_attempt, 1) as parse_attempt_no, coalesce(ipa.source_revision, iti.source_revision) as source_revision from ingestion_task_item iti inner join ingestion_task it on it.id = iti.task_id left join ingestion_item_execution ie on ie.id = iti.current_execution_id and ie.item_id = iti.id left join ingestion_item_parse_attempt ipa on ipa.id = ie.parse_attempt_id and ipa.item_id = iti.id where it.kb_id = #{kbId} and it.id = #{taskId} and iti.status = 'FAILED' order by iti.created_at asc, iti.id asc

select iti.id from ingestion_item_execution ie inner join ingestion_task_item iti on iti.current_execution_id = ie.id and iti.id = ie.item_id where iti.status in ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') and ie.execution_status = 'ACTIVE' and ie.claim_version < 9223372036854775807 and (ie.next_action_at is null or ie.next_action_at <= current_timestamp(6)) and (ie.lease_token is null or ie.lease_until <= current_timestamp(6)) order by ie.next_action_at asc, ie.id asc limit #{limit}

select iti.id from ingestion_item_execution ie inner join ingestion_task_item iti on iti.current_execution_id = ie.id and iti.id = ie.item_id where iti.task_id = #{taskId} and iti.status in ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') and ie.execution_status = 'ACTIVE' and ie.claim_version < 9223372036854775807 and (ie.next_action_at is null or ie.next_action_at <= current_timestamp(6)) and (ie.lease_token is null or ie.lease_until <= current_timestamp(6)) order by ie.next_action_at asc, ie.id asc limit #{limit}

select iti.id as item_id, iti.progress as item_progress, ie.id as execution_id, ie.execution_epoch, ie.phase, ie.claim_version, ie.lease_token from ingestion_task_item iti inner join ingestion_item_execution ie on ie.id = iti.current_execution_id and ie.item_id = iti.id where iti.id = #{itemId} and iti.status in ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') and ie.execution_status = 'ACTIVE' and ie.claim_version < 9223372036854775807 and (ie.next_action_at is null or ie.next_action_at <= current_timestamp(6)) and (ie.lease_token is null or ie.lease_until <= current_timestamp(6)) limit 1 for update skip locked
mapper.update: update ingestion_item_execution ie inner join ingestion_task_item iti on iti.current_execution_id = ie.id and iti.id = ie.item_id set ie.phase_retry_count = ie.phase_retry_count + case when #{candidate.leaseToken} is not null then 1 else 0 end, ie.lease_token = #{leaseToken}, ie.lease_until = timestampadd(second, #{leaseSeconds}, current_timestamp(6)), ie.claim_version = ie.claim_version + 1, ie.phase_started_at = coalesce(ie.phase_started_at, current_timestamp(6)), ie.next_action_at = null, ie.updated_at = current_timestamp(6), ie.finished_at = null where ie.id = #{candidate.executionId} and ie.item_id = #{candidate.itemId} and ie.execution_epoch = #{candidate.executionEpoch} and ie.phase = #{candidate.phase} and ie.claim_version = #{candidate.claimVersion} and ie.claim_version < 9223372036854775807 and ie.execution_status = 'ACTIVE' and iti.status in ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') and (ie.next_action_at is null or ie.next_action_at <= current_timestamp(6)) and (ie.lease_token is null or ie.lease_until <= current_timestamp(6))

update ingestion_task_item iti inner join ingestion_item_execution ie on ie.id = iti.current_execution_id and ie.item_id = iti.id set iti.stage = #{projection.stage}, iti.status = #{projection.status}, iti.progress = #{projection.progress}, iti.error_code = null, iti.error_message = null, iti.updated_at = ie.updated_at, iti.finished_at = null where iti.id = #{itemId} and ie.id = #{executionId} and ie.execution_status = 'ACTIVE' and ie.lease_token is not null

ipa.request_snapshot as request_snapshot,
null as request_snapshot,
parse_artifact.object_key as parse_result_object_key, parse_artifact.artifact_version as parse_result_artifact_version, parse_artifact.provenance as parse_result_artifact_provenance, parse_artifact.producer_claim_version as parse_result_producer_claim_version, parse_artifact.content_sha256 as parse_result_sha256, embedding_artifact.object_key as embedding_result_object_key, embedding_artifact.artifact_version as embedding_result_artifact_version, embedding_artifact.provenance as embedding_result_artifact_provenance, embedding_artifact.producer_claim_version as embedding_result_producer_claim_version, embedding_artifact.content_sha256 as embedding_result_sha256 from ingestion_task_item iti inner join ingestion_task it on it.id = iti.task_id inner join ingestion_item_execution ie on ie.id = iti.current_execution_id and ie.item_id = iti.id left join ingestion_item_parse_attempt ipa on ipa.id = ie.parse_attempt_id left join ingestion_item_artifact parse_artifact on parse_artifact.execution_id = ie.id and parse_artifact.artifact_type = 'PARSE_RESULT' left join ingestion_item_artifact embedding_artifact on embedding_artifact.execution_id = ie.id and embedding_artifact.artifact_type = 'EMBEDDING_RESULT' where iti.id = #{itemId} and iti.status = 'RUNNING' and ie.execution_status = 'ACTIVE' and ie.lease_token = #{leaseToken}
mapper.update: update ingestion_item_parse_attempt ipa inner join ingestion_item_execution ie on ie.parse_attempt_id = ipa.id and ie.item_id = ipa.item_id inner join ingestion_task_item iti on iti.current_execution_id = ie.id and iti.id = ie.item_id set ipa.request_id = #{doclingRequestId}, ipa.job_id = #{doclingJobId}, ipa.source_revision = #{sourceRevision}, ipa.request_snapshot = cast(#{parseRequestSnapshot} as json), ipa.updated_at = current_timestamp(6) where iti.id = #{itemId} and ie.execution_epoch = #{executionEpoch} and ie.phase = #{expectedExecutionStage} and ie.claim_version = #{claimVersion} and ie.lease_token = #{leaseToken} and ie.execution_status = 'ACTIVE' and iti.status = 'RUNNING' and ipa.attempt_no = #{parseAttempt} and (ipa.request_id is null or ipa.request_id = #{doclingRequestId}) and (ipa.source_revision is null or ipa.source_revision = #{sourceRevision}) and ( ipa.request_snapshot is null or ipa.request_snapshot = cast(#{parseRequestSnapshot} as json) )

update ingestion_task_item iti inner join ingestion_task it on it.id = iti.task_id inner join ingestion_item_execution ie on ie.id = iti.current_execution_id and ie.item_id = iti.id set iti.stage = #{stage}, iti.status = #{status}, iti.progress = #{progress}, iti.error_code = #{errorCode}, iti.error_message = #{errorMessage}, iti.updated_at = coalesce(#{updatedAt}, current_timestamp(6)), iti.finished_at = #{finishedAt} where iti.id = #{itemId} and iti.task_id = #{taskId} and it.kb_id = #{kbId} and ie.execution_epoch = #{executionEpoch} and ie.claim_version = #{expectedClaimVersion} and ie.execution_status = case when #{nextExecutionStage} = 'COMPLETE' then 'SUCCEEDED' when #{nextExecutionStage} = 'FAILED' then 'FAILED' else 'ACTIVE' end and #{progress} >= iti.progress

update ingestion_item_parse_attempt ipa inner join ingestion_item_execution ie on ie.parse_attempt_id = ipa.id and ie.item_id = ipa.item_id inner join ingestion_task_item iti on iti.current_execution_id = ie.id and iti.id = ie.item_id set ipa.request_id = #{doclingRequestId}, ipa.job_id = #{doclingJobId}, ipa.source_revision = #{sourceRevision}, ipa.request_snapshot = cast(#{parseRequestSnapshot} as json), ipa.status = case when #{status} = 'FAILED' then 'FAILED' when #{nextExecutionStage} not in ('PARSE_SUBMIT', 'PARSE_WAIT', 'PARSE_PERSIST') then 'SUCCEEDED' else ipa.status end, ipa.updated_at = coalesce(#{updatedAt}, current_timestamp(6)), ipa.finished_at = case when #{status} = 'FAILED' or #{nextExecutionStage} not in ('PARSE_SUBMIT', 'PARSE_WAIT', 'PARSE_PERSIST') then coalesce(#{updatedAt}, current_timestamp(6)) else ipa.finished_at end where iti.id = #{itemId} and ie.execution_epoch = #{executionEpoch} and ie.claim_version = #{expectedClaimVersion} and ipa.attempt_no = #{parseAttempt}
mapper.select: select ie.id from ingestion_task_item iti inner join ingestion_item_execution ie on ie.id = iti.current_execution_id and ie.item_id = iti.id where iti.id = #{itemId} and ie.execution_epoch = #{executionEpoch}

select iti.id as item_id, iti.task_id, it.kb_id, iti.status as item_status, iti.updated_at as item_updated_at, iti.current_execution_id, coalesce(ie.execution_epoch, iti.execution_epoch, 1) as execution_epoch, ie.execution_status, coalesce(ipa.attempt_no, iti.parse_attempt, 1) as parse_attempt_no, coalesce(ipa.source_revision, iti.source_revision) as source_revision from ingestion_task_item iti inner join ingestion_task it on it.id = iti.task_id left join ingestion_item_execution ie on ie.id = iti.current_execution_id and ie.item_id = iti.id left join ingestion_item_parse_attempt ipa on ipa.id = ie.parse_attempt_id and ipa.item_id = iti.id where it.kb_id = #{kbId} and it.id = #{taskId} and iti.id = #{itemId} and iti.status = 'FAILED' and coalesce(ipa.attempt_no, iti.parse_attempt, 1) = #{expectedParseAttempt} for update
mapper.update: update ingestion_task it join ( select task_id, count(1) as total_count, sum(case when status in ('SUCCESS', 'SKIPPED') then 1 else 0 end) as success_count, sum(case when status = 'FAILED' then 1 else 0 end) as failure_count, sum(case when status = 'RUNNING' then 1 else 0 end) as running_count, sum(case when status = 'PENDING' then 1 else 0 end) as pending_count from ingestion_task_item where task_id = #{taskId} group by task_id ) s on it.id = s.task_id set it.total_count = s.total_count, it.success_count = s.success_count, it.failure_count = s.failure_count, it.running_count = s.running_count, it.status = case when s.running_count > 0 then 'RUNNING' when s.pending_count > 0 then 'PENDING' when s.failure_count = s.total_count then 'FAILED' when s.success_count = s.total_count then 'SUCCESS' else 'PARTIAL_SUCCESS' end, it.updated_by = #{updatedBy}, it.updated_at = #{updatedAt}, it.finished_at = case when s.running_count + s.pending_count > 0 then null else #{updatedAt} end where it.kb_id = #{kbId} and it.id = #{taskId}
